posts.name: Octavian
posts.cooked:
From one of the designers, Kevin G. Nunn, on facebook:
 

For the last year, a single game design has consumed me. Sentinels of the Multiverse: the Board Game. In only a few days, the SotM:BG will make its world debut at Gen Con.

http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.com/

It's been a huge undertaking. Getting to play in the Greater Than Games sandbox has been incredibly rewarding. Having the opportunity to bring a new dimension to their characters made me grow as a designer. Luther Hendricks has been a fantastic design partner who brought his own flair to the project. You'll want to be the first to check it out.

See you at Gen Con!

posts.name: Theta_Sigma
posts.cooked:
From Iron Legacy's bio 

 

"When she reached 18 years old, Felicia was given a Legacy costume by her parents, and her father began training her in earnest. Her whole life had been dedicated to the pursuit of justice and preparing herself for the inevitable combat against evil, and she took to this new training like a champion. The years of crime-fighting with the Freedom Five were hard work, but some of the best years of her life.

Years later, Felicia Parsons was the best prepared to accept her father's death at the hands of Baron Blade."

 

If the Young Legacy we see is 18, we have an unspecified number of years until Legacy dies. He might die after Tactics, even. Or like Pydro said, the timelines may just be that messed up.
